scenario: Same information architecture as generic-metric-first after a cosmetic pass: borders, shadows, and card chrome were removed, but aggregate metrics still outrank live execution.

review.summary: Chrome was removed; the underlying metric-first structure was not. The original IA finding is unresolved.
alternative_constraints: Do not treat borderless metrics as a structural change.
One direction must make active execution the first-viewport object.

findings.title: Cosmetic pass left the same hierarchy
findings.observation: KPI values remain the strongest first-viewport content. Active runs still begin below the fold. Only card borders, shadows, and radius changed.
findings.product_mismatch: Operators still cannot see failing or stalled runs without scrolling. Flattened chrome does not restore the primary job.

evidence.fact: Four large metric values still dominate; live execution is absent from the first viewport.
Render order is still metrics grid, then activity, then runs table.

findings.revision_constraint: Do not count removal of borders or shadows as resolving an information-architecture finding.
